method: One authorized fresh native profile run, followed after process exit by one invocation of the unchanged original all-suite assessor. Independent archive checks of saved source inventories/current frozen input bytes, raw frame/RSS counts and checkpoint/response consistency; no capture retry or altered budget.

measured_process_rss.scope: Whole instrumented process during measured interactions; sampled peaks may miss shorter spikes. This gate cannot establish component allocation cost or absence of leaks.

interpretation: These are explicit engineering defaults, not official Flutter thresholds or a user-approved product budget.
Frame percentiles use nearest rank and the complete independent FrameTiming arrays, not bounded VM timeline retention.
Build and raster stages are assessed separately because rendering is pipelined; totalSpan includes scheduling and is not a count of displayed dropped frames.
The fixed measured-process RSS limits are a desktop harness risk gate; component memory and leak assessment remain unassessed even when it passes.
One passing observed run does not establish repeat-run stability or acceptance on other devices, platforms, accessibility configurations or physical input.

source_integrity.scope_note: Acceptance checks the listed build/runtime inputs and git revision. Changes to out-of-scope documentation/tests are reported by worktree status and do not alter this manifest.

source.scope: Complete core/library/Catalog runtime sources and core font/icon assets, all integration targets/drivers, native macOS sources/project and plugin registrant, dependency/toolchain pins, generated Swift package manifest, profile runner/snapshot tool/evaluator/budget. xcuserdata and timestamp-bearing .flutter-plugins-dependencies excluded; external package implementation is represented by the lockfile and compiled bundle inventory.
source.worktree_note: The detached checkout began clean. Flutter dependency preparation generated out-of-scope packages/docs native configuration and Podfiles before source_before.json; that worktree status is unchanged across capture. No clean-whole-worktree claim is made.

runtime.legacy_metadata_note: locale and semantics_enabled retain the historical platform-dispatcher meaning; widget locale and framework Semantics are recorded independently.

renderer.observation_status: Not exposed by the Flutter public runtime API; inspect the saved engine launch log.

launcher_metadata.renderer_observation_status: No backend announcement found in the captured launch log; requested/default backend remains unverified.

native_preparation.observation_note: Readiness requires observed resumed lifecycle, frame progression and stable geometry/semantics flags after explicit Start. It is preparation evidence, not measured frame timing or independent proof of window visibility.

operator_controls.authority: Root and capture-agent session observations; these are operational notes, not a separate host telemetry recording.
operator_controls.temporary_idle_assertions: caffeinate -di wrapped the original runner; no OS power/lock settings changed and no power-assertion sidecar was added.
operator_controls.window_activation: Root used native Window makeKeyAndOrderFront, observed resumed and 1728x1080 dp, then clicked Start.
operator_controls.during_measurement: Root stopped GUI actions after Start; other agents paused local CLI/tests/downloads. The capture agent only waited on the already-running capture session. No ad-hoc top/process sidecar was introduced.
operator_controls.other_applications: Root reported no IINA in the pre-capture CUA inventory. No playback or unrelated application state was changed. No continuous host process/CPU/GPU inventory was recorded.

checkpoint_validation.checkpoint_15_to_16_note: Task Rows active_await diagnostics advance to suite cleanup; do not interpret whole-map byte identity as required. Sample arrays and completed workload outcomes remain retained.
checkpoint_validation.independent_read_only_review: A separate reviewer checked all checkpoint sequences, payload equality and boundary ordering without rerunning the assessor.

timeline_evidence.verification_scope: The real driver successfully decoded all compressed timelines using its byte-length/SHA-256/event-count validation path. Artifact SHA-256 values identify the written raw timeline files, while timeline_transport.json_sha256 identifies original compact JSON encoding bytes. Bounded VM retention can still omit older events.

checks: SHA-256 of original compact JSON encoding
independent_transport_payload_validation.note: The reviewer compared event-count declarations across envelopes and final reports. The actual driver decoder separately enforced traceEvents.length before writing each timeline. All written files are independently hashed in raw_artifacts; retained event counts do not prove an untruncated VM history.

launch_warning.meaning: Preserved in launch.log. This run actually completed the VM-service request_data response and all checkpoints; response result is true with zero failureDetails. No Android instrumentation or XCTest result-upload claim is made.
